name: Wishful Thinking
source:
A young woman searching for her big break in journalism soon uncovers a criminal conspiracy with the help of her superpower.

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Category:Wishful_Thinking]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
一名年輕女子正在尋找能讓自己在新聞界嶄露頭角的機會，卻很快藉由自己的超能力揭開了一場犯罪陰謀。

[摘自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Category:Wishful_Thinking]Choices Wikia[/url]]
